themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: This theme covers AI agents designed to autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with data or systems to achieve research objectives.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: This theme focuses on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, often by generating code snippets or offering suggestions.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: This theme explores the use of AI to create simulated users for testing, training, or data generation purposes, particularly in scenarios like testing AI models or marketing campaigns.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: This theme addresses how AI tools are being used by product managers for tasks such as ideation, feature development, and understanding user needs.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: This theme covers a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to facilitate research activities, from data analysis to literature review and experimental design.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: This theme focuses on AI's role in analyzing customer feedback, reviews, and social media to gauge sentiment and extract actionable insights.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: This theme addresses AI's capability to condense large amounts of text, such as meeting notes, research papers, or customer feedback, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: This theme covers AI applications in the design process, including generative design, AI-assisted ideation, and research into AI's impact on design.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: This theme pertains to the use of AI in evaluating the usability of products and interfaces, including automated testing and analysis of user interactions.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: This theme covers AI tools and techniques that directly support and enhance the processes of design and research, bridging the gap between the two.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
